name: USX MOUNT Height Adjustable Universal Speaker Stands (1 Pair)
description: USX MOUNT universal floor speaker stands (1 pair, Model: XAS502). Designed with an adjustable collar mechanism to extend the height from 30.0 to 39.1 inches, perfect for setting satellite or small bookshelf speakers at optimal ear level. Features a heavy-duty alloy steel square base with a loading capacity of up to 11 lbs per stand. Includes a built-in internal channel for clean cable management, plus rubber feet and carpet nails for multi-surface stability. Excellent condition, ideal for surround sound setups. Selling cheap for graduation moving sale!
name_zh: USX MOUNT 可调节高度通用环绕音箱落地支架 (一对装)
description_zh: USX MOUNT 品牌通用款有线环绕音箱/卫星箱落地金属支架（一对/两支装，型号：XAS502）。高度可通过内置锁扣在 30.0 英寸至 39.1 英寸（约 76-99 厘米）之间自由随心调节，轻松将音响固定在最佳听音高度。单支高强度合金钢底座可稳固承重达 11 磅（约 5 公斤）。带有隐藏式走线槽保证整洁，附赠硬地橡胶脚垫及地毯防滑钉。品相良好，毕业低价打包转让！
